compression.docs:
**string**: The compression algorithm used for the embedded web assets. Options are `gzip` or `br` (Brotli). Brotli provides ~24% smaller size than gzip, but some browsers only support Brotli over HTTPS connections. Since the captive portal is served over HTTP, gzip is recommended for maximum compatibility. Defaults to `gzip`.

*See also: [Captive Portal](https://esphome.io/components/captive_portal#configuration-variables)*
